reasoning: The request parameter 'password' obtained via @RequestParam Map<String,String> is attacker-controlled. It is concatenated directly into the response string without any escaping or sanitization and returned inside a GenericVulnerabilityResponseBean which is rendered by the HTML template associated with the endpoint. This constitutes a reflected XSS sink.

proof_of_concept.description: Reflected XSS by injecting a script tag into the password parameter.
proof_of_concept.expected_effect: The response page will contain: "Correct! The password was '<script>alert(1)</script>'..." which, when rendered by the browser, executes the alert dialog, demonstrating XSS.
